description: This PHP source file defines the WeakPasswordResetController class, which manages the password reset process for weak passwords within the authentication module of the OrangeHRM system. It handles the pre-render logic, validating reset codes, and preparing the data for the frontend component.

classes.name: WeakPasswordResetController
classes.description: Controller handling the weak password reset process, extending the AbstractVueController and implementing the PublicControllerInterface, mainly responsible for preparing the reset password component with necessary data.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component for rendering by validating the reset code, fetching username, and setting properties such as error messages or invalid code flags, and then setting the component and template for the view.
